title: Deeper/broader peer output-integrity and layout-failure route reconciliation
mode: primary-source peer issue research, local source/test audit, and plan-only update
scope: Reconcile newly surfaced LibreDWG writer reports against local DXF string and OBJECTS routes
Review ACadSharp plot-setting and encoded-string failure reports against local DWG reader/writer paths
Turn only local evidence gaps into small generated implementation-ready checks

method.kind: Read primary GitHub issues/commits, Autodesk references, local source, and existing tests
method.limitations: Peer issue bodies are report evidence tied to named versions and operations, not independently reproduced findings in libdxfrw. The proposed layout and string checks remain plan items; no local runtime result is claimed.

sources.revision: Issue pages and linked commits reviewed 2026-10-18; release adoption not verified
sources.observed: #1412 reports uninitialized/stale bytes entering DXF text through NUL termination at the allocation boundary and strlen-based sizing; linked commits add last-written-byte termination and a zero-length group emission guard. #1413 reports a positional NOD selection failure when a lower-handle extension dictionary precedes the actual NOD.
The NOD is the first OBJECTS object. PLOTSETTINGS group 78 applies only when group 77 is Custom (5); the documented active custom DPI range is 100 through 32767.

sources.revision: Open issue bodies reviewed 2026-10-18; #1184 names 3.6.35/3.6.51 and #1234 names 3.6.51, 3.7.1, and master 91ae384a
sources.observed: #1184 reports that a setter rejecting stored ShadePlotDPI=0 can discard all DWG LAYOUT objects. #1234 reports SummaryInfo value loss beginning at 16,383 characters and warns that the same peer reader does not reliably reveal the writer corruption.

sources.revision: Working-tree source/test audit at baseline de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
sources.observed: The local DXF sinks write explicit string_view lengths, the NOD-first generated ASCII/Binary test already covers a lower-handle extension dictionary and output order, PLOTSETTINGS/ LAYOUT parse paths retain parsed integers without a setter range check, and generic DWG CP8/UTF-16 writers reject byte/code-unit counts above 0xFFFE before narrowing. Existing DPI DXF controls do not cover the cited DWG LAYOUT read route; no exact generic DWG string-limit test was found in the reviewed test sources.

assessment.planImpact: Adds two focused generated checks under existing owners: DWG LAYOUT stored shade-DPI retention and generic CP8/UTF-16 encoded-length boundaries. Records that NOD ordering already has exact generated coverage and that LibreDWG's C cquote defect is not the same local C++ string-sink implementation.

implementationReadyChecks: Extend the existing PAR-20/7G LAYOUT/PLOTSETTINGS target with a locally generated DWG containing inactive 77=2/78=0 and valid custom 77=5/78=300, and assert raw field position, layout callback, owner/NOD dictionary closure, and a following record.

Extend an existing fast writer-primitives target to test encoded CP8 byte and UTF-16 code-unit lengths at 0xFFFE and 0xFFFF; include an astral input so code units are not confused with Unicode scalars or UTF-8 bytes.

For each accepted string-boundary control, inspect the wire length and following sentinel independently of same-reader roundtrip; for refusal, assert error state and no wrapped length/output publication.
Do not add a generic SummaryInfo claim: the peer's 16,383 boundary belongs to its own route and is not the local generic sink limit.
Reuse existing NOD-first tests rather than adding a duplicate; keep the six J items deferred and non-promoting.
